title: Phase Extractor
text: Extract the unwrapped phase of a complex input, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough; {Unwrap phase only within the frame} and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Unwrap phase only within the frame
params.values: Unwrap phase only within the frame off (default) | on

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
